heading: Color that breathes
subtext: Each card gets a unique gradient derived from the theme's accent color. Vibrant, cohesive, and effortless.

items.title: Auto-generated gradients
items.description: Gradients are derived from --accentColor using color-mix(). Swap themes, the entire row recolors.

items.title: Accessible contrast
items.description: Text remains readable over gradients thanks to the accentContrast token. No accessibility trade-offs.

items.title: Subtle animation
items.description: A slow hue shift on hover brings cards to life without being distracting or performance-heavy.

items.title: Dark mode ready
items.description: Gradients invert naturally in dark mode. The same card reads differently but equally well in both modes.
